3.o: Alisha is having fun using and abusing her powers but she can't seem to get the one man she really wants: Curtis.

1.o: Takayama Naoto is a high school second-year who dreams of being a train conductor. In hopes of getting a job with Japan National Railways, one of the most stable businesses in Japan due to government support, Naoto has applied to an on-the-job training program for students.

2.t: Let Me Stay Like This for Just a Little While
2.o: Having qualified for on-the-job training, Naoto is assigned to K4, the Tokyo Central Railway Security 4th Guard Team. Waiting for him there are his partners from JNR Central Academy: Aoi, Haruka, and Sho. They immediately set about their work at Tokyo Station, but as if being teamed up with the gruff Aoi didn't worry him enough, Naoto is increasingly anxious as he watches the Tokyo Public Security Mobile Police set out on a mission.

3.o: Sassho Mari, like Naoto, is a second year at Kiryu Railway High School. She's into cooking, cleaning, doing laundry, and collecting recordings of train sounds. In hopes of working as an attendant in a railway-related company, she's begun on-the-job training with JNR's subsidiary, Japan Restaurant Enterprise Co., Ltd.

4.t: I Think I Might Like It
4.o: The popular idol Kashima Noa is named the honorary railway security team leader for the day, and K4 is appointed to guard her. They accompany Noa on the Odoriko special express to a JNR-sponsored event taking place on a beach near Ito Station.

5.o: Early in the morning, Naoto is dragged into shooting practice with Aoi beneath Tokyo Station. When they finish, Aoi still doesn't seem satisfied. Then Naoto gets a message from Mari about plans for their school's trip the next day.

6.o: The members of K4 have been punished with at-home suspension for their reckless actions on the Ashio Line. Naoto is relaxing at home when he receives a note in the mail that turns his mood upside-down: an anonymous death threat. He calls Aoi for advice, but there's no answer.

7.o: Naoto and the other K4 members head to Karuizawa for Advanced Railway Security Force Training. Naoto is excited to hear that they'll have a course on operating an EF63 electric locomotive. Aoi accompanies him in shooting lessons and strength training, saying she doesn't want him to slow her down as they'll be working in railway security together, but Naoto tells her he's aiming to be an engineer instead, leading to an argument.

8.o: Misunderstandings further threaten the harmony among the K4 members. Even the weather is on a rampage, causing a landslide near Karuizawa. Meanwhile, an employee of the Japanese Organs Transit System tells station attendants that she must get an organ to the hospital in Maebashi as quickly as possible for a transplant operation, but both railways and roads are closed due to the heavy rains.

9.o: Naoto and K4 head toward Yokokawa as the rain plummets down. Haruka says the track from Usui Bridge No. 3 to Yokokawa should be safe since it's regularly maintained for the opening of the Usui Abt Railway, but the downgrade is steep, they can't slow down, and the narrow tunnels make it difficult to handle curves... They're in a serious pinch when Iwaizumi takes action!

10.t: Will You Keep This a Secret?
10.o: Prince Bernina of the small Mediterranean kingdom of Atella has arrived in Japan to attend a sister city ceremony in Sapporo, and the K4 members are appointed to guard and guide him on his way there. Naoto and the others are about to board the Hokutosei 3 at Ueno Station when Aoi contacts Naoto and tells him she's pursuing a suspicious man who was watching the platform.

11.o: Naoto and the others managed to fight off their attackers on the Hokutosei, but while on the run, Naoto and Bernina find themselves under attack again. This time it's Aoi who comes to the rescue after catching up with them in Sendai via the Tohoku Shinkansen. Just as he breathes a sigh of relief, Naoto's phone rings...

12.o: After seeing the others back to Tokyo while they cleaned up the aftermath of the Hokutosei incident, Naoto and Iida wait at Aomori Station. The engine that will pull their train to Tokyo is the KiHa 381, equipped with a pendulum-style, diesel-fueled gas turbine engine. Shortly after they depart, Naoto hears a strange sound and can't shake the feeling that something isn't right.

6.o: Eva merkt tot haar grote blijdschap dat ze zwanger is. Om Peter te doen geloven dat het zijn kind is, moet ze aan haar relatie met Peter gaan werken, vooral ook aan de relatie tussen de lakens. Tot die tijd kan ze haar blijdschap over de zwangerschap alleen maar delen met Rebecca, haar 'partner in crime', maar die komt in grote problemen als ze erachter komt dat Steef een dubbelleven leidt.

7.o: Rebecca probeert erachter te komen wat Steef nog meer voor haar verborgen houdt. Voor Steef wordt het steeds moeilijker alle ballen in de lucht te houden, hoewel hij de toffe peer blijft spelen ten opzichte van Peter. Peter weet dat Eva zwanger is en dat voor hem verzwijgt. Hij raakt steeds achterdochtiger en als Eva hem eindelijk vertelt dat ze zwanger is en beweert dat het kind van Peter is, gelooft hij haar niet.

8.o: Het eens zo zonnige leventje van Rebecca en Steef wankelt. In plaats van steun te zoeken bij de buren houdt Rebecca afstand van Eva. Ze weet inmiddels dat Steef drager is van een erfelijke ziekte en dat Eva's kind mogelijk niet goed is. Eva komt steeds meer alleen te staan met haar geheim, want ook Peter houdt afstand. Hij gaat heimelijk Eva´s gangen na, vastbesloten te bewijzen dat hij wordt belazerd.

9.o: Steef kan niet anders meer dan Rebecca het geheim opbiechten dat hij jarenlang voor haar verborgen heeft weten te houden. En ook op zijn werk moet hij met de billen bloot, het kost hem voorlopig zijn functie. Ook bij de buren wordt gebiecht. Eva geeft toe dat het kind niet van Peter is maar ze weigert het te laten weghalen. In plaats daarvan slaat ze op de vlucht.

10.o: Steef en Rebecca likken hun wonden. Peter is behoorlijk doorgedraaid en gaat achter Eva aan zodra hij ontdekt dat ze weg is. Als Steef beseft dat Peter zijn pistool heeft gestolen, besluit hij met Rebecca achter Peter aan te gaan om te voorkomen dat er ongelukken gebeuren.

1.o: Twelve-year-old Princess Yuki is starting to take on the responsibilities of leading her kingdom. But when the borderland knights Yuni and Lune are rude to her, her retainer Joshua challenges them to a battle in a simulator.

2.o: In order to hold back the advancing Imperial Army at the border, Grand Master Harold takes the royal flagship to the front lines. Joshua throws himself into his first combat sortie in order to protect Yuki's smile.

3.o: A soldier of the Imperial Army, Petty Officer Stella Shining always seems to keep her squad at arm's length. When she and her squad are deployed on a mission with their new commander, he wonders what lies behind her ever-present smile.

4.o: Two months have passed since the kingdom and the empire went to war, and the empire continues to advance. As Layla tries to support the despondent Yuki, she thinks back on the tragedy that started it all.

5.o: To break through a stalemate a stone's throw from the capital, the Buerger Squad embarks on a night mission. But when Lily runs into unexpected trouble, she ends up relaying her past to Commander Owens.

6.o: Nothing stops the advance of the Grandiga empire, despite the valor of the troops of the Sun kingdom. While most of the residents are evacuated to a safe place, Princess Yuki wonders if it would be wiser to capitulate.

7.o: After the Battle of Hariant, Gail Squadron soldiers try to find the food they need to hold a small party in honor of Pierce who was wounded in action.

8.o: While Yuki takes command of the Royal Army, Izana tries to smuggle crucial information about the ruined Empire of Verde from behind enemy lines.

9.o: With the Kingdom hanging on by a thread, Grand Master Harold ramps up production on the new chrars. But Yuki and Layla pursue a different path based on the data sent by Izana.

10.o: The Empire surges onward, but life is grim for soldiers on the front lines. As she survives through tough situations with her teammates and commander, Stella's smile begins to change.

11.o: Winter has arrived. Yuki has lost many of those important to her, but she continues to press onward. As the war reaches its final stages, Yuki defiantly claims she will retake Hariant...

12.o: As the final battle rages on, Yuki and Stella arrive on distant foreign soil. Yuki has made up her mind to end the war, but Stella stands in her way. What future will these girls bring to their world?

1.o: After Ned and Jesse Banks publish a video of a mysterious outback accident that involved a couple of teenagers and a lorry from a classified research facility, they then have to deal with a political machine that is desperate to keep the truth hidden.

2.o: As Ned investigates the truck accident in the remote town of Lindara, Jesse comes face to face with the 'extraordinary' new powers of the law.

3.o: Wracked by guilt that Jesse has paid such a high price for trying to help his investigation, Ned fears the worst when he discovers Jesse missing.

4.o: Ned and Jesse are on the run; their house has been ransacked, their phones bugged, and their computers tracked. With no one to turn to, their only hope is to find the truth in Lindara.

5.o: Ned and Jesse are forced into an impossible choice - Hani's life in exchange for technology capable of wiping entire cities from the face of the earth.

6.o: Unless Ned and Jesse take action, their fates will be sealed, their story repackaged, and the truth will remain neatly beneath the radar. It is time to do something radical.

1.o: Jesse and Ned are facing the possibility of extradition to the US to face serious charges. Fortunately Australian National Security is sitting on an explosive case they can't crack, and Jesse might just be the man to do it.

2.o: Kidnapped by Roth, Jesse and Hani disappear into the jungles of West Papua. Hoping it will buy them time to find the data the authorities need, Jesse reluctantly makes a deal unlock an encrypted file.

3.o: Racing to save Remsey from false imprisonment and find Callum, Jesse and Roth forge an unlikely alliance. Ned contacts an undercover photojournalist to help find Jesse.

4.o: Ned and Jesse are hiding with Roth, and Jesse lies to save his own skin and Hani's father. A political rally turns ugly as Jesse works furiously to decrypt the files.

5.o: Roth vows revenge after the death of a relative, while Jesse is torn between genuine care for Roth & the need to disarm the digital time bomb that is waiting to explode.

6.o: Roth is ready to show the world what it feels like to be brutalised and be powerless to stop it. With Roth’s shocking plan set in motion Jesse Banks must answer the question once and for all – whether violent means can deliver peaceful ends…

2.o: Amir and Adham’s death is faked using two other people. Amir kills the officer who was assigned to oversee their escape after he learns that he was ordered to kill them in the forest.

3.o: Amir and Adham escape after the officer is shot. Amir’s sister learns of his execution and breaks down. The neighborhood's chief tells her that the people don’t want Amir to be buried in their village.

4.o: The authorities learn that Adham and Amir survived the execution and start looking for them. They suspect that Amir may come back to avenge his wife who cheated on him. Adham and Amir go to hide at Abu Al-Azm’s place.

5.o: Amir, Adham, and Abu Al-Azm go to a friend for fake passports. They meet the girl Samara who asks them for two million for the passports. Abu Al-Azm decides to mortgage his shop. Meanwhile, the authorities try to keep what happened at the prison under wraps.

6.o: Amir’s sister decides to leave the village. Amir goes to his house to check up on it and then goes back to Abu Al-Azm’s house. Abu Al-Azm asks Amir’s sister about their brother Ahmed and she tells him that he died.

7.o: Abu Al-Azm warns Amir against going back to his apartment. He tells Adham about his relationship with Amir. A dead body is buried in Amir's stead. The police arrive at Abu Al-Azm’s place.

8.o: Abu Al-Azm and Adham get arrested. Amir is able to escape with Samara and Abu Al-Azm's friend. Amir threatens Essam to release Adham and Abu Al-Azm.

9.o: Samara informs Amir that Atuf is her mother's husband. She tries to get closer to him but he rejects her, saying he only cares about seeing his children. The police decide to release Abu Al-Azm and keep Adham to put pressure on Amir.

10.o: The prison warden finds out about Amir and Adham's escape. Amir records a video where he recounts everything that happened to him and Adham. Samara gets into an argument with Atuf and tells him about her love for Amir.

11.o: Amir tells Samara that he killed the children of an official after they harmed his mother and another person, and she decides to support him. He leaves a recording behind when his whereabouts are discovered.

12.o: A disturbance in prison results in the death of the prison warden. Amir confesses to Samara his desire to see his children and tells her that his wife is unfaithful.

13.o: Samara and Amir decide to go and see his children and she tells him that she wants to get engaged to get read of Atuf's control. Essam returns Adham to Abu al-Azm's home. Atuf tells Essam about Amir's whereabouts. Investigations regarding the prison fire are started.

14.o: Essam tells Amir that he does not intend to harm him and informs him about the prison warden's death. Amir gives the recording to Ragheb. Samara goes to Amir's wife, who tells her that she sent the children to their grandfather's home.

15.o: When Adham kills himself, Amir decides to keep the news from Essam. Essam arranges a dinner between the prison officials and Amir to discuss his demands.

16.o: Amir demands that his case is reopened so that he is proclaimed innocent. Samara tells Amir that his children are with their grandfather. Essam threatens Samara and tells her that she can marry Amir in return for her silence.

17.o: Essam comes up with a plan to get Amir back to his village, concocting a story that spirits protected Amir. Essam insists on meeting with Adham.

18.o: Abu Al-Azm and Samara go to the village with Amir while she pretends to be paralyzed. She tells the people of the village that Amir came to her in a dream and told her to come to the village for one day in order to recover, and she meets Amir's family.

19.o: Essam learns about Adham's suicide. The people of the village are astonished to see Samara walk and they honor Amir. The man responsible for Amir's mother's death comes forward to cast doubt on Samara's claims.

20.o: Amir's enemy asks Samara to confess that she was lying in return for money, but she refuses. The villagers are surprised to see Amir at a shrine in the village.

21.o: Amir meets with his children and is taken to the station to be questioned about his return. Amir's enemy plots to kill him.

22.o: The village's elder goes to the Sheikh who prepared Amir's body for burial and discovers that the body was disfigured. Judge Marwan announces to the people of the village that Amir was killed in prison and his body was disfigured in a subsequent fire.

23.o: The people of the village question Amir about what happened to him, and he tells them that they will die if he tells them the truth. Amir proposes to Samara and decides to go to Atuf to ask for her hand.

24.o: Ragheb tells Essam that Safwan came to prison and reviewed the inmates' records. Amir's friend from the village brings Amir's wife and Amir divorces her. Amir's family asks him for an explanation but he refuses to tell them the truth.

25.o: As a new investigation with Ghalib commences, Ragheb and Essam both grow wary and consider leaving the country. Ragheb meets with Amir and tells him that he has to turn Essam in or they will all be arrested.

26.o: Ragheb keeps Amir detained. Essam gets his assistant to arrest all the meeting's attendees and takes them to prison.

27.o: Essam forces Ragheb to admit to everything. Essam agrees with the police to pretend that they planned everything that happened. Samara tells Ruba the truth. Amir is set free and Essam tells him to return to the village.

28.o: Essam asks Amir to sacrifice either Abu Al-Azm or Samir. Nashaat Al-Wazzan decides to kill everyone who was involved in the kidnapping, including Essam and Amir. Amir and Samara get into an argument over Samara telling Ruba everything.

29.o: Amir's wife comes to get their children after going to the police. Amir prepares for his wedding the following day.

30.o: During the wedding, Nashaat records a video where he admits everything. A plan is made to arrest Essam and Amir but Essam gets wind of it and escapes with Amir.

1.o: In an alternate America where police conceal their identities behind masks to protect themselves from a terrorist organization, Detective Angela Abar investigates the attempted murder of a fellow officer under the guidance of her friend and Chief, Judd Crawford. Meanwhile, the Lord of a Country Estate receives an anniversary gift from his loyal servants.

2.o: As Angela relives haunting memories of an attack on her family, she detains a mysterious man who claims responsibility for Tulsa’s most recent murder. Elsewhere, an original play is performed for an audience of one.

3.t: She Was Killed by Space Junk
3.o: Following a late-night visit from the senator who authored Masked Policing Legislation in Oklahoma, FBI agent Laurie Blake heads to Tulsa to take over the recent murder investigation. The Lord of The Manor receives a harshly worded letter and responds accordingly.

4.t: If You Don't Like My Story, Write Your Own

5.o: The origin story of Looking Glass is at last revealed, as is the truth behind the greatest hoax in American history. Far away, The Smartest Man In The World plots a daring escape.

6.o: Deep under the influence of Nostalgia, Angela gets a firsthand account of her grandfather’s journey.

7.o: Under Lady Trieu's care, Angela undergoes an unconventional treatment while Agent Blake chases down a lead. Elsewhere, The Smartest Man in The World delivers a stunning defense of his past actions.

8.o: Angela's mysterious past in Vietnam is at last revealed.

1.o: When war breaks, translator Harry Chase vows to help his Polish lover Kasia flee Warsaw, but how will he explain this to his sweetheart Lois, waiting for him at home in Manchester?

2.o: A month after the outbreak of war, Warsaw is unrecognisable, while Manchester, on the surface, appears very much the same. Will there be a warm welcome home for Harry?

3.o: December 1939, and Tom fights for his life on board the HMS Exeter at the Battle of River Plate. Meanwhile, Harry and Lois have a more personal battle to fight.

4.o: Harry’s courage is tested at Louvain as he comes face to face with a German sniper, and Kasia’s resistance activity in Warsaw intensifies.

7.o: On a Polish mission as part of the SOE, Harry grasps a second chance at saving Kasia from the horrors of Warsaw, while Lois looks set for happiness with new love, Vernon. Season finale.

1.o: Yilin Patriarch Wei Wuxian died in the battle with three biggest clans happened in No Night City. After 16 years later, Mo Xuanyu from Mo residence sacrifices himself and bring Wei Wuxian back to get revenge for him. The same day, juniors from Gusu Lan Sect came to Mo residence to solve some trouble. When Wei Wuxian is awake, he found out juniors can't handle it, so, he tries to help them.

2.o: After Wei Wuxian left Mo Residence, he arrived at Dafan mountain. Then he encounters the Dancing God. While dealing with the Dancing God, he meets with two old friends.

3.o: We go back 16 years where Wei Wuxian is still part of the Yunmeng Jiang sect. He travels with the elder brother and sister of the clan, Jiang Cheng and Jiang Yanli. He encounters the very strict Lan Wanggji for the first time here.

4.o: While students were performing greetings, Wen Chao from Qishan Wen Sect along with Wen Ning and Wen Qing arrived at Gusu Lan Sect. A misunderstanding is caused. Luckily, no one was hurt. After that, Wei Wuxian met with Wen Ning.

5.o: Wei Wuxian gets punished for a mistake he made in the class. After a few days, Wei Wuxian, Jiang Cheng go together with Lan Sect to Caiyi Village to a solve water spirit problem.

6.o: Wei Wuxian and Lan Wangji find out about the greatest secret hidden in Gusu Lan Sect for a long time.

7.o: Because of Wei Wuxian and Jin Zixuan's fight, the engagement between Jin Zixuan and Jiang Yanli was called off.

8.o: Wei Wuxian, Jiang Cheng and Jiang Yanli left Gusu Lan Sect together with Yunmeng Jiang's Sect's leader as a result of Wei Wuxian's fight with Jin Zixuan. But Wei Wuxian didn't go home. He left a note and then goes and finds Lan Wangji. Then two of them go on a journey to find the rest of Silver Metals. Meanwhile, Wen Chao finds another piece of Silver Metal.

9.o: The three heroes sleep within the cave of the Dancing Goddess, but during the night she comes alive and they fight her off. Shortly after an army of ghost puppets arrive at the cave. Wen Qing works together with them to save the people.

10.o: Wei Wuxian, Lan Wangji and Jiang Cheng meet with Xiao Xingchen and Song Lan. Then they take the person responsible to what happened to Yueyang Cheng Sect who was captured by Xiao XIngchen and Song Lan to Qinghe Nie Sect. There, they learned that they have to go to Qishan Wen Sect to learn some manners. After a few days, Wen Chao from Qishan Wen Sect attacks Qinghe Nie Sect.

11.o: Wei Wuxian and Jiang Cheng go back home. Meanwhile, Gusu Lan Sect was attacked by Wen Xu from Qishan Wen Sect. After a few days, Wei Wuxian and Jiang Cheng left home and go to Qishan Wen Sect. There, they find out Lan Wangji is also there.

12.o: When they are at Qishan Wen Sect, because of Wen Chao, Wei Wuxian already has to face a lot of troubles. Thankfully, Wen Ning is quietly helping him. At the same time, Wei Wuxian learns Gusu Lan Sect has been destroyed by Qishan Wen Sect.

13.o: Wen Chao takes them to hunt beast which is in the Tu Lu Xuan Wu cave. A lot of things happened in there which leads to Wei Wuxian and Lan Wangji have to spend some time in the cave.

14.o: After sleeping in the cave, Wei Ying and Lan Zahn come up with a plan to fight the elemental beast and gather arrows, rope and whatever they can find. Wen Zhao is instructed to find Xue Yang and the last piece of Yin metal.

15.o: A leader from a small clan arrives wounded at Lotus Pier. Wuxian and Cheng are left in charge while their father and sister look for a safer place to heal the clansman. In their absence Wang Lingjiao provokes Madam Yu into battle.

16.o: When Wei Wuxian and Jiang Cheng are on a boat, they meet with Jiang Fengmian who came back. They told him everything. Then Jiang Fengmian ties Wei Wuxian, Jiang Cheng and Jiang Yanli and let them go far away from home. As for him, he goes back to Yunmeng Jiang Sect to save his wife. 1.o: تؤتي رغبة المدرب في تغيير فلسفة لعب الفريق ثمارها، لينطلق غلطة سراي في سلسلة من ألقاب الدوري التركي المتتالية.

2.o: رغم ترشيحات تضعه في خانة المستضعفين، يقود المدرب غلطة سراي في رحلة ملهمة نحو التتويج بكأس الاتحاد الأوروبي.

3.o: من تدريب المنتخب التركي إلى الدوري الإيطالي، تشهد مسيرة المدرب انتصارات مبهجة وهزائم مريرة.

4.o: يستعرض المدرب المسيرة المذهلة للمنتخب التركي في بطولة أمم أوروبا 2008، وعودته لتدريب غلطة سراي.

1.o: 2011. Otaku culture has been eliminated in Japan. A resistance army hides in Akiba. When leader Otaku Hero loses the will to fight, comrade Magical Girl Anarchy relights his fire. The army then moves to liberate the otaku prison camp at Tokyo Big Sight.

2.o: Otaku Hero, Anarchy, and Blue get a lead on Pink's whereabouts from super hacker Nick. The group heads to Pink's hideout to try to get her to join forces with them.

3.o: Joined by Pink, the three Magical Girls are now reunited. While Otaku Hero and the girls hold a rally at a maid café in Akihabara, one of SSC's Four Heavenly Kings launches a giant robot to face them in battle. What is behind Unit-@'s hatred of otaku?

4.o: After Otaku Hero loses a beloved toy robot in the Kanda River, he and the girls are confronted by the hostile middle-aged members of the Mansei Bridge Otaku Commune. The two generations enter a contest to fight over the true definition of otaku culture.

5.o: Otaku Hero takes the girls behind enemy lines in Shibuya to find an elderly collector with a drug that amplifies magical powers. The collector agrees to provide the drug in exchange for a rare figurine set locked away in the SSC base at Nakano Sunplaza.

6.o: With Otaku Hero and the girls in Nakano, SSC launches an attack on the Akiba Liberated Zone. The other otaku struggle to defend their base. On the way back to Akiba, Otaku Hero recalls his past with the magical girls and his first encounter with Shobon.

7.o: On their way back to Akiba, Otaku Hero and the girls are confronted by two of SSC’s Four Heavenly Kings—Adam and Eve. They get trapped in a cyberspace where Otaku Hero and Anarchy must defend against relentless attacks and cheats to rescue Blue and Pink.

8.o: Otaku Hero, Nick, and the other otakus get together to discuss the planning for the upcoming Wanku event. From merch, to guests, and even a possible physical media release, it's all on the shoulders of the appointed lead producer, Otaku Hero.

9.o: SSC forces attack the otaku at the Wanku! event with an army led by two of the Four Heavenly Kings—the silent Himawari and her overbearing older brother. Pink and Blue have to take the power-up drugs from Chogo-shi to defend against the deadly siblings.

10.o: With the thought of Anarchy's return casting a shadow over the otaku army, Otaku Hero rallies the troops and prepares for one final battle. Otaku Hero leads a direct attack on SSC headquarters while the magical girls stay to defend Akiba from Slayer.

11.o: The notebook that Otaku Hero found in the SSC base explains the origin of Shobon's hatred for otaku and foreshadows a dangerous fate for the magical girls. Running through the empty streets of Tokyo, Otaku Hero races back to try to change the script.

12.t: What You Like, as Much as You Like
12.o: Once Slayer's blood transforms the magical girls into Magical Destroyers, Shobon moves his story toward its planned climax. There is little Otaku Hero can do to resist. What will be the fate of the otaku army and otaku culture in SSC's planned New World?

1.o: تبدأ "كوين" بالوقوع في حب "ستاتن" الغارق في أحزانه، فلا يلاحظ أي من مشاعرها، مما يُفسح المجال أمام "ديفيس" الذي يرى في ذلك فرصة سانحة. فيما يهزّ وصول شخص متجوّل غامض هدوء البلدة.

2.t: Sure as the Day Is Long
2.o: يتبع "ستاتن" دليلًا رئيسيًا في تحقيقاته، فيما تُبرم "كوين" صفقة تنطوي عليها عواقب مقلقة، ويجد "لوكاس" صعوبة في ضبط سلوك شقيقه.

3.o: يشتعل الصراع في حفل إعادة الافتتاح الكبير لقاعة الرقص، وثمة وجه مألوف من ماضي "يانسي" يظهر بشكل مزعج.

4.t: That Boy Is My Whole Heart
4.o: ثمة خلاف بين "ريد" ووالده يمنحه الفرصة لتوطيد علاقته بـ"ستاتن"... حتى لو كان ذلك يعني العمل إلى جانب "لوكاس". فيما يحاول "ديفيس" الفوز بقلب "كوين".

5.o: فيما تتوّج علاقة "ديفيس" بقربه أكثر من "كوين"، يتعرض للتهديد من قبل زوجته السابقة التي تُضمر خطة شريرة تسعى من خلالها للقضاء على "ستاتن" و"كاب".

6.t: We Need to Talk About Reid
6.o: تزرع "بولا جو" الفتنة والخصومة بين "ستاتن" و"كوين"، فيما تنبش "إيلي" في ماضي "يانسي". أما "لوكاس" و"لورين"، فيتوصلان إلى اكتشاف صادم.

7.o: ينتهي المطاف بـ"ستاتن" و"كوين" بالاحتماء في مكان قريب بعدما يضرب المنطقة إعصار، وثمة اعتراف يميط اللثام عن اكتشافات جديدة في التحقيقات الجارية في وفاة "راندل".

8.o: لا يزال "دان" متخبطًا في شكوكه على الرغم من توقف التحقيق في القضية، وتضغط "إيلي" على "يانسي" لحمله على الاعتراف لـ"كاب"، فيما تستعد "لورين" لاختبارها المهم في التشجيع.

9.o: يتحتم على "كوين" اتخاذ قرار نهائي في الوقت الذي تحتار فيه بمشاعرها وأحاسيسها، ويصبح تحالف "ستاتن" و"ديفيس" الهشّ عُرضة للتهديد، فيما يواجه "كاب" ندمه في الماضي.

10.t: Maybe It's Time Yancy Grey Dies Too
10.ar: ربما حان الوقت لنسيان يانسي غراي
10.o: تصل الأجواء المحتدمة بين "ستاتن" و"ديفيس" إلى الذروة، وتكتشف "إيلي" أمرًا صادمًا. أمّا "دان"، فيتعين عليه أن يتخذ قرارًا بإظهار الحقيقة مهما كان الثمن أو السكوت عنها.

1.o: تعود "كوين" إلى الديار لتكتشف أنّ والدتها في البلدة. وعلى صعيد آخر، تحتدم التوترات بين "ستاتن" ووالده في المزرعة. أمّا "يانسي"، فينفد صبره من شريكته في السكن.

2.t: Edge of My Seat Here, Quinn
2.o: تنشب عداوة محتدمة إثر تحول مفاجئ في موازين القوى داخل مزرعة "دوبل كاي"، وتصطحب "كوين" الرجل الذي يطارد قلبها في جولة عبر البلدة... وترسم في ذهنها خطة واعدة لإنعاشها.

3.o: تبدأ مؤامرة محفوفة بالمخاطر خلال مباراة العودة لكرة القدم، ويعرض "ستاتن" على "كوين" أن يساعدها في التواصل مع غريمة قديمة من أجل مشروعها الموسيقي الجديد.

4.o: تتكشف خيانات الماضي وتطفو المشاعر الدفينة ليصبح عشاء في منزل عائلة "أوغرايدي" حافلًا بكشف الحقائق، بينما يفسد "كيت" نهاية سهرة الأفلام الدافئة التي تجمع "لوكاس" و"لورين".

5.o: ينطلق "ستاتن" في رحلته حاملًا دوافع خفية. وفي حين تستعد "كوين" للمهرجان، يساعدها "أوليفر" على استعادة صلتها بالبلدة عبر معلم تاريخي منسي.

6.o: تفرض بعض التعقيدات خلال رحلة بريّة على "كوين" و"ستاتن" الانفراد ببعضهما. وعلى صعيد آخر، تدخل خطة "يانسي" و"سيدني" و"إيلي" حيز التنفيذ، لكنّها سرعان ما تخرج عن مسارها.

7.o: بينما يجتاح الحماس للمهرجان بلدة "رانسوم كانيون"، تُهدّد سلسلة من التعقيدات كلّ ما بذلته "كوين" وفريقها من مجهود.

8.o: في ظلّ غموض مصير مزرعة "دوبل كاي"، يتأمل "ستاتن" و"كوين" معنى الانتماء، بينما تجتاح البلدة لحظات من الحب والخسارة.

1.o: After causing trouble, Dong-ju is demoted to the Insung Metropolitan Police Agency, where he's treated like dead weight and his fellow world-class medalists also face discrimination and scorn. But when a major case erupts, it reignites the fire in their hearts.

2.o: At Man-sik's suggestion, a special criminal investigation team is formed with the former world-class medalists. Ready for a fresh start, each member joins with their own hopes and goals, but behind the creation of this special team lurks a hidden agenda.

3.o: Convinced that Ju-yeong is the hit-and-run driver, Dong-ju scrambles to find evidence. Meanwhile, Jong-hyeon heads to the Prosecutors' Office at Man-sik's request to investigate Gyeong-il's case, and Ju-yeong meets someone in the shadows.

4.o: The Special Criminal Investigation Team is now complete with Han-na's return and Jong-hyeon joining. They launch a full-scale investigation into Gyeong-il's death and Min Ju-yeong. As they split into teams and close in on their targets, Han-na receives her father's case files.

5.o: While investigating Ju-yeong, the Special Criminal Investigation Team is forced to hand him over to the prosecution after their sudden intervention. Dong-ju is hospitalized for tests following his car accident, and the team digs deeper into Ju-yeong's true identity and his connections to the prosecution.

6.o: Using Han-na's surprise kiss as an excuse, Dong-ju heads out alone with her on an investigation and discovers Ju-yeong's burner phone. Jong-hyeon finds himself growing uneasy as Dong-ju and Han-na get closer. Meanwhile, Drugmon, under surveillance in an apartment, begins plotting her escape.

7.o: Dong-ju's assault puts the Special Criminal Investigation Team in a major crisis. Man-sik fights to keep the team together, while the others continue investigating Ju-yeong, weighed down by uncertainty. Meanwhile, Ju-yeong leaves the hospital and heads to an unknown destination.

8.o: The Special Criminal Investigation Team catches wind of Ju-yeong's drug smuggling and infiltrates the customs office disguised as a quarantine unit. Following a lead left by Drugmon, they manage to find the container hiding the drugs but walk straight into a trap set by Ju-yeong.

9.o: Han-na is kidnapped, and Dong-ju and Jong-hyeon rush to rescue her, only to find themselves trapped in a deadly crisis. Just when it seems there's no way out, an unexpected gunshot rings out. With an unforeseen sacrifice shaking the team, will they survive?

10.o: The Special Criminal Investigation Team is disbanded in the end. Dong-ju quietly prepares revenge against Ju-yeong alone, but his reckless move only invites a greater crisis. Catching on to his plan, Ju-yeong launches a counterstrike.

11.o: The Special Criminal Investigation Team reunites and uncovers Joo-young's big secret. Frightened by Dong-joo's countdown challenge, Joo-young takes desperate measures. So who will win in the end?

12.o: Falling into Ju-yeong's trap, Dong-ju suffers a critical injury and faces his greatest crisis yet. Will he push through or fall where he stands?

13.o: With no way to retreat, Dong-joo and the team launch their final all-out attack on Joo-young. Moving in without hesitation, they soon face a fierce counterattack and unexpected difficulties. What is written in their fate?

15.o: The entire Inseong police force unites and launches a massive operation against Joo-young's gang. But just when they are close to victory, Joo-young's most devastating counterattack throws the entire city into chaos.

16.o: Amidst the chaos, Dong-joo and Team Inseong begin their decisive battle to determine the fate of the city. Carrying the weight of everyone's hopes and expectations on their backs, will they be able to achieve the ultimate victory and emerge as true heroes?
